We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development. Track alignment design experience in various railway contexts, including heavy freight trains, passenger railways, and LRT. International Rail project experience and familiarity with Canadian and North American Railway standards, including AREMA. review_candidates.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Engineer – Quality Control & Billing (Highway Projects) Company: Garima ECC Pvt. Ltd. Industry: Infrastructure / Roads & Highways / EPC Construction Location: Gujarat – Project Sites / Vadodara Head Office Department: Project Execution – Quality Control & Contracts Experience Required: 8–12 Years Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Civil Engineering (preferred) or Diploma in Civil Engineering with substantial relevant experience Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company Garima ECC Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure construction company engaged in highways, road construction, maintenance and strengthening, bridges, and government infrastructure projects. We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineer – Quality Control & Billing with strong technical expertise in highway construction, field laboratory operations, material testing, quantity measurements, and preparation of contractor bills. 1. Quality Control & Material Testing - Independently manage quality control activities for road and highway construction projects. - Supervise and perform field and laboratory testing of bitumen, aggregates, soil, GSB, WMM, DBM, BC, and other highway construction materials. - Ensure testing and quality compliance as per MoRTH, IRC, IS, and relevant project specifications. - Conduct and verify aggregate gradation, impact value, crushing value, flakiness and elongation index, abrasion, and water absorption tests. - Conduct and supervise bitumen testing, including penetration, softening point, ductility, viscosity, and specific gravity, as applicable. - Handle Marshall Stability tests, bitumen extraction, gradation analysis, and Job Mix Formula (JMF) verification. - Monitor asphalt batch-mix plant quality, production temperatures, material consumption, and mix conformity. - Conduct field density, compaction, layer thickness, and other highway quality tests. - Maintain laboratory registers, test reports, calibration records, and quality documentation. - Coordinate material approvals and inspections with the Authority Engineer, PMC, and departmental engineers. 2. Billing & Quantity Surveying - Independently prepare and submit Running Account (RA) Bills and Final Bills for highway projects. - Prepare and verify Measurement Books (MB), quantity sheets, and supporting billing documents. - Calculate executed quantities for earthwork, GSB, WMM, DBM, BC, concrete, drainage, and other road construction items. - Prepare reconciliation statements for bitumen, aggregates, cement, steel, and other construction materials. - Monitor BOQ quantities, variations, extra items, and excess quantities. - Prepare rate analysis and supporting documentation for extra and substituted items. - Coordinate with clients, consultants, and government departments for bill checking, certification, and payment follow-up. - Maintain billing records and monitor certified quantities against actual execution. 3. Site Coordination & Documentation - Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Surveyors, and Plant Teams. - Ensure timely approval of materials, mix designs, and executed work. - Maintain daily progress reports, inspection records, and quality-related correspondence. - Identify quality deviations and recommend corrective measures. - Assist in technical correspondence, contractual documentation, and project audits. 4. Preferred Industry Experience Strong preference will be given to candidates having previous experience with reputed infrastructure companies or highway consultants, including: - Larsen & Toubro (L&T Construction) - LASA India - Patel Infrastructure Ltd. - RKC Infrabuilt - GHV India - IRB Infrastructure - Other reputed EPC highway contractors or supervision consultants Candidates should have direct experience in National Highway, State Highway, Expressway, or major road construction and maintenance projects. 5. Essential Technical Skills - Thorough knowledge of MoRTH specifications and relevant IRC/IS standards. - Practical experience in highway field laboratory testing. - Knowledge of bituminous mix design and asphalt quality control. - Proficiency in MS Excel, AutoCAD, and quantity calculations. - Independent preparation of RA Bills, MBs, and material reconciliation. - Understanding of BOQ, SOR, rate analysis, and variation statements. - Ability to coordinate with government departments, Authority Engineers, and PMCs. 6. Candidate Profile We are looking for a technically sound, result-oriented professional who: - Has a minimum of 8 years of relevant highway construction experience. - Has worked with a reputed highway EPC contractor or consultancy. - Can independently handle both QC laboratory operations and project billing. - Has strong documentation and communication skills. - Is comfortable working at project sites across Gujarat. - Can take ownership of quality approvals, bill preparation, and certification follow-ups. Compensation Salary: Competitive, commensurate with relevant experience, technical competency, and previous employer. Job Location: Gujarat, with deployment across ongoing highway and infrastructure projects. Apply to: This Post and siddharthshah@garimaecc.com Position: Engineer – Quality Control & Billing (Highway Projects)

review_candidates.description: Director, GraphAware Engineering Location Based in Italy, Czechia, Spain, the Netherlands or the UK, working remotely with teams across Europe. Occasional travel for team gatherings, Neo4j and customers. PLEASE NOTE THAT YOU MUST BE LOCATED IN ONE OF THE LOCATIONS LISTED TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR THE ROLE. The role We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Hume engineering: about 25 engineers in five product-aligned teams, plus the DevOps team, working across Europe. Hume is a graph-powered intelligence analysis platform. Analysts in law enforcement, customs, financial crime and national security use it to find the connections that matter in their cases. You will report to the Senior Director for GraphAware Products, who leads both product and engineering. You will work as a peer of the Director of Product Management. You have two core responsibilities, and they matter equally. The first is the people: grow the engineering team in size, skills and knowledge, by hiring well and by coaching engineers into stronger engineers, tech leads and future leaders. The second is the system that lets those teams decide autonomously and deliver well: clear team ownership, sound decisions, predictable releases, secure practices and effective AI-assisted development. The two reinforce each other: a good system helps people grow faster, and people who grow keep improving the system. Engineering should not depend on a few individuals to resolve every architecture, release or staffing question, and that includes you. This is a leadership role. You will not write production code day to day. You need enough technical depth to earn senior engineers' respect, ask the right questions in a design review and diagnose a production incident. Then you hand the decision back to the people who own it. What you will own Teams and people. Lead, coach and grow the team leads and tech leads. Build management and senior technical career paths, hiring within the team, and plan succession so no area depends on one person. Delivery. Own engineering's organisation-wide commitments. Put in place planning, checkpoints and tracking that the teams run themselves, so risks and dependencies surface early. Release quality. Treat everything we ship as the product: installation packages, Helm charts, Docker Compose, configuration and documentation, tested on every deployment environment we support, including on-premises and restricted environments. Own the definition of done, code-review discipline and vulnerability mitigation within agreed targets. Secure engineering. Work with our Security & Compliance colleagues, who run the ISO 27001 programme, and make sure engineering practice meets it. Technical ownership. Be accountable for Hume's overall technical excellence: architecture, code quality, performance and security. Challenge and shape the major technical decisions together with the tech leads, and set how decisions are made, challenged and recorded. Delegate design to tech leads and principal engineers, and evolve the architecture so most changes need only one team. Set clear guidance on where AI-assisted development helps and where it doesn't. DevOps. Lead the DevOps team and own its priorities, balancing the teams' requests against platform improvements. How you will work You care about the problem we solve. Product owns what we build and why; engineering owns how and whether it is feasible. You care about the why as well. You understand how an investigation runs and what an analyst needs, and you join customer conversations to hear it first-hand. You bring trade-offs and alternatives to the Director of Product Management early, before commitments are made, so product and engineering plan as one. You are part of the Science & Technology team, as well as engineering's leader. You bring engineering's view into its decisions early and openly, and you challenge them, including your manager's. Once a decision is made, you own it with your teams and explain the reasoning behind it. You build trust in both directions: engineers know their view is heard, and the leadership team can rely on engineering's commitments. You communicate clearly, in writing first. You write updates people can act on, and decisions are recorded where everyone can read them. You explain difficult decisions plainly to engineers, to Neo4j colleagues and to customers. You bring decisions, not only questions. You own engineering's response to customers and the field. In practice that means three things. Customer escalations and production issues get a named owner, a response and follow-through to the fix. Deployment and support questions from field engineers and customers are answered within agreed targets. And the release dates and scope the field shares with customers are ones engineering has committed to, agreed with the product team. You are the escalation point when something is stuck. What you need to bring Experience leading an engineering organisation of about 20 or more people across several teams, through tech leads or engineering managers, accountable for both delivery and people. A strong background as a senior engineer and tech lead in backend, data or platform systems. You can review architecture across a JVM backend, a modern web front end, AI/LLM components and CI/CD. Experience reorganising engineering teams around product domains, using Team Topologies, strategic Domain-Driven Design or similar, and bringing people with you through the change. A track record of improving delivery, quality and release practices for a complex product that customers deploy themselves. Clear written and spoken communication in English, and experience leading distributed teams across countries. Nice to have Graph databases (especially Neo4j), knowledge graphs or GraphRAG. Building LLM-based or data-intensive products in production, and leading teams through adopting AI-assisted development. Products for law enforcement, government or other security-sensitive customers. Leading engineering through an acquisition or integration into a larger company. What this role is not Not the sole architect or a full-time coder: design belongs to the tech leads, and you make sure it is challenged and written down. Not the product owner: you shape what we build through partnership with the Director of Product Management, not by deciding it. Salary is set individually for each candidate, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria such as experience, skills and scope of responsibility. Contract under the collective bargaining agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria). This information applies to Italy only. For other countries, please speak with the recruiter.
